name: revenue against budget
description: Projected revenue from allocation against the base budget, month by month: hard and soft revenue, projected revenue as the share of each that converts, the base budget, attainment (projected ÷ budget), the shortfall to budget, the hard and soft shares, and hours with no charge-out rate. For a subsidiary, and a pillar when one is named.

params.during: the months to cover — a span, or relative like { "this": "month" }
params.subsidiary: the revenue subsidiary's id; 2 is Fusion5 Pty Ltd (AU), 3 is Fusion5 Ltd (NZ)
params.pillar: a pillar's name (CEC, BC, FO, …), or none for every pillar
params.currency: the currency to report in; the organisation's by default

hard conversion.description: The share of hard-allocated revenue that becomes actual revenue.

soft conversion.description: The share of soft-allocated revenue that becomes actual revenue.
